$comment: CC-MODE-HUB F1 — THE mode registry. Single source of truth for what a mode IS, where it appears, and who may see it. The Play hub renders only from this file; deleting an entry removes the mode from every surface with zero code changes (A1.1). DATA, not code: adding a mode is an entry here plus its implementation module, never a new conditional in a surface.
$provenance: Every field below is transcribed from SHIPPED behaviour, not invented. `status` follows each flag's compiled-in default in src/flags.rs; `kidSafe` mirrors `kid_ok` in tools_hub.rs's TOOLS table; `platforms` follows each flag's documented runtime gate; `nameKey`/`descKey` reuse the existing tools.* catalog entries (F2 forbids new auditable content, and these already exist in all 13 locales).

$deviations.tools_hub: F1/D1 says the settings toggles are DELETED and the registry replaces them. src/tools_hub.rs ('Pillar 3') shipped in build 55 (d9a6583) with its own 4-test E2E spec and is the ONLY way to flip a shipped-dark flag. Deleting it is a reversal of a days-old decision, so it is KEPT pending Eric. Consequence, stated plainly: until he rules, mode metadata lives here and tools_hub still owns its DOM-binding table (flag -> element ids). Those are different concerns, but `status`/`kidSafe` must not drift — whoever retires Pillar 3 should make it read this file.
$deviations.entitlementLevel: The spec models gating as a single CC-ENTITLEMENTS level. That does not cover photo_list, which needs the `photo_ocr` PARENT-PREMIUM boolean rather than a language level. Modelled as an extra `requiresPremium` field rather than mangled into entitlementLevel; flagged for Eric.
$deviations.online_spelloff: Not among the six modes CC-MODE-HUB names, but it is a shipped mode (332 lines, flag OFF pending backend deploy). A registry that omits a shipped mode is not a single source of truth, so it is here as coming_soon.
$deviations.attempts_shields: Deliberately ABSENT. It is a Climb mechanic, not a discoverable mode, and CC-MODE-HUB's constraints say shields belong to CC-CLIMB-SHIELDS. It stays a tools_hub row only.

$fields.status: live = renders as a tappable Play-hub tile. coming_soon = non-tappable teaser. hidden = renders nowhere, for anyone. core = a base-game surface this registry GOVERNS but never renders as a tile (CC-ONBOARD-JR option (a), signed 2026-09-11): the base game, The Climb and the Daily Challenge are entries here so that juniorPolicy reaches the surfaces a child actually plays.
$fields.kidSafe: true = survives the Little Speller hub. Little Speller shows ABSENCE, not locks — the zero-purchase-surface doctrine carried over.
$fields.platforms: Where the mode can function at runtime. A mode absent on this platform does not tile.
$fields.entitlementLevel: Minimum per-language AccessLevel (none < preview < full). A mode requiring `full` on a previewed language is ABSENT, not locked (A2.3).
$fields.requiresPremium: Optional parent-premium entitlement (EntitlementSet boolean) this mode needs, or null. See $deviations.
$fields.languages: Language codes the mode supports, or null for any. Absent outside them.
$fields.ordering: Hub tile order = FILE order (D6, RECONSTRUCTED — Eric must confirm). No popularity sort, no per-user reordering in v1.
$fields.juniorPolicy: REQUIRED (I4 — a missing policy fails the build). What Spell Jr may do with this mode, read by experience::allowed_tiers and nothing else. ceiling:<tier> = offer tiers up to and including <tier>. variant:<id> = junior plays a junior variant (Jr Climb, Jr Daily), always Easy + Medium. hidden = absent from every junior surface. ungated = the mode has no difficulty ladder (Reports, Calendar); junior is still held to Easy + Medium defensively, so a future word source cannot leak Hard.

$decisionsPending: D6 (RECONSTRUCTED): tile ordering = registry file order. Implemented as stated; confirm.
D7 (RECONSTRUCTED): coming_soon tiles carry no notify-me hook in v1. Implemented as stated; confirm.
D1: whether tools_hub ('Pillar 3', build 55) retires in favour of this registry — see $deviations.

modes.$note: CC-PRACTICE: first among modes (D9). Per-language availability = consts::practice (D7: en pre-audit exempt; others await the interim-content ruling).
CC-HUB-CLEANUP D4: user-facing name is Spell Racing (tools.racing.name); internal id stays ghost_racing per CC-SPELL-RACING.
modes.statusNote: AUDITPASS F7 / D2 (Eric, 2026-08-06): Spell Racing is cut. Hidden removes every tile; the compiled flag default stays ON so the code path survives one release and a revert is a flag flip, not a git revert. Delete the code next release if there is no reversal.

modes.$note: es-only: it needs syllabification data, and absence is data-driven (CC-MODE-HUB I4.1).

The mode CC-MODE-HUB calls 'ocrMode'/'Photo/OCR' is `photo_list` here. Gated by the photo_ocr parent-premium entitlement — see $deviations.entitlementLevel. CC-HUB-NAV v1.3.1 H3: status was `hidden`, which permitted() rejects first, so it had no drawer row -- and the Phase C cut-over had already retired the utility row its button lived in. It was reachable from nowhere in build 252.

CC-SPELL-ALOUD-INTEGRATION Feature 6: shown on ALL platforms(ios) languages; per-language availability is the language registry's voiceSpell gate (consts::voice_spell / VOICE_SPELL_LANGS), which opened to every registered language under Eric's mic-everywhere ruling 2026-07-27 -- it read en,es before that and this note said so until 2026-10-02 -- and now holds FOURTEEN: ko was withdrawn 2026-10-03 because Korean voice spelling cannot compose a syllable (see consts::VOICE_SPELL_LANGS and norm.rs::ko_voice_spelling_needs_positional_jamo_not_a_lexicon_edit). The unavailable tile therefore only appears for an UNREGISTERED code now (play_hub::a7_spell_aloud_is_available_in_every_registered_language pins that). What still varies per language is the runtime ladder in spell_aloud::reflect: on-device installed gives a live mic, downloadable gives a mic with a download badge, and a language with no on-device path falls to the server rung behind a consent card -- never in Kid Mode, never in education builds. Available is not the same as verified: thirteen of the fifteen letter lexicons are machine-drafted and still pending native review. languages:null (not a list) so an unsupported language shows the unavailable tile rather than being filtered out (A7).

F8/D5: hidden until spec'd and reviewed — a hard gate. The spec proposal ALREADY EXISTS: docs/word-stories-review.md (37e5a0f), which recommends keeping it hub-hidden pending (1) CC BY-SA attribution via the CC-WORDLIST-SOURCES Tier-B credits surface and (2) a kid-appropriateness spot-check of the en/es strings. Its flag is OFF for the same reason. `hidden` here matches all of that.
Flag OFF because /api/match is not deployed yet — 'ships dark until then' IS coming_soon. See $deviations.online_spelloff.

CC-DEF-MATCH: P3 loop live. Per-language activation = consts::def_match (D3 pool floor + interim-content ruling); inactive languages render the unavailable teaser. PREVIEW depth = easy tier only (defmatch::allowed_tiers).

STRINGS SIGNED by Eric 2026-08-13. LIVE. Per-language offer is forge::forge_ready — Hindi is excluded because its bank cannot sustain a board. Flipped on with two gaps Eric accepted: Done #4's Korean jamo block-assembly capture was never reviewed, and F4's daily archive and F5's how-to cards do not exist, so a first-time player gets no intro.

STRINGS SIGNED by Eric 2026-08-13. LIVE. The three D1 settings are DATA in chains::Strictness, so reversing one is a table edit rather than a code change and one language can move without the others. As built: vi diacritic-SENSITIVE, zh tone-INSENSITIVE, ja dakuten flexible. The zh tone call is the one Eric flipped live WITHOUT a native check — tones are lexical, but casual 接龙 does not require them and the toneless reading triples the successor pool. Untimed mood only: D3's Timed mood, its clock ring and D4's dead-end rejection are not built, nor is Phase 2 pass-and-play. ko/pl/ru/hi median 7-9 links.

STRINGS SIGNED by Eric 2026-08-13. LIVE. D3 bank-vs-dictionary gap ACCEPTED 2026-08-12: the validity screen checks the audited BANK, not a dictionary, so a distractor that is a real word absent from the bank still renders (arid for acid). ko sits at 3.0% exclusion against D3's 2% REVIEW TRIGGER — examined and accepted, because the excluded words are single-block Korean and excluding them is correct rather than a defect. D1 built as option B: shape transforms everywhere, nine authored English trap classes. Reveal-why is English-only per I4. Not built: D7 tier gating beyond the free easy set, F4 how-to cards, D6 analytics write.

STRINGS SIGNED by Eric 2026-08-13. LIVE. The 24-name contestant table went live WITHOUT a line-by-line review — it is displayed content in every market, and Eric flipped it knowing that. Flags were removed first so the table carries no claim about anybody's origin; what ships is given names and a colour. D3's Definition request is NOT BUILT and cannot be: definitions arrive from /api/defpool over the network and D7 requires offline, so I1 renders no button. Not built: F4 how-to cards, D5's spoken letter input (a v2 door by the spec).

CC-WORD-PICTURE v5: calligram mode — words typeset along guide strokes. Menu grows to 4 (CC-HUB-CLEANUP D5 reconciliation: Word Picture registered second, per that spec's own note). PREVIEW = free trio from pictures.json; Kid Mode = computed eligibility (tier<=medium + kid-filtered feed).

CC-HUB-NAV C1/F4. A SURFACE, not a mode: it has no round and never tiles in the Play hub, but the drawer lists it and I2 says a row resolves through this registry, so it is governed here — the same reason CC-ONBOARD-JR option (a) put the base game, The Climb and the Daily here. juniorPolicy records what the button already does: importBtn is not Kid-Mode gated today. descKey repeats nameKey because a core surface never tiles and the drawer renders no description (D-N3), so no description is ever read.

CC-HUB-NAV C1/F4a. As my_words: a surface the registry governs so the drawer can resolve it. missesBtn is never Kid-Mode gated — it is DISABLED when nothing is due, which is a state, not a policy — so juniorPolicy is ungated.

CC-REPORTS D1: kid tab FREE (drives daily play). Conquest framing only (I4); guardian diagnostics live behind the parent gate, never here. Little Speller: registry-filtered out by its edition profile.
CC-CALENDAR v2: kid surface; goals originate HERE only (I7 CI-enforced). D2: view/recap/goals free; multi-week planner Complete (checked in-surface). Parent side is read+cheer in the dash.

CC-TRANSLATE-TOOLS core (D5 signed: whole suite app-only). Closed space (I1): bank words only, lookup via pick-only UI (I4). Fan-out rows arrive through the gloss_rows seam when CC-BANK-TRANSLATE lands; today cards render the word's own row — absent, not locked. Wave 2/3 tools build per their gates.

CC-SPELLDOKU v1: Sudoku committed by spelling number words. App only (D9). A language plays only when its number-word table is servable in this build (D3); otherwise the tile is the unavailable teaser. Spell Jr: 4x4 Easy and 6x6 Medium (F7).

CC-WORDGRID v1 Phase A: a word search where every target is heard, never shown (F-S1), with trap spellings from the hand-authored confusion list (F-S2). App only. Launch set en, es, ru, fr, de, pt, pl, fil; English alone has decoys and all five tiers, the rest play Easy (D11). Under-13 players get the Jr grid only (F-X5). ko and zh never (D4).

CC-WORDGRID v1 Phase B: a criss-cross of the list's own words, every clue heard and never read (D1, F-C1). App only. Same launch set as Spell Search; crossings are weighted onto trap positions at Jr, Easy and Medium and off them at Hard and Expert (F-C2), and a list that will not interlock five words is offered as a Spell Search instead (D2, F-C7).

CC-SPELLUZZLE v1 Phase B: a rune cipher where the words on a board depend on each other. App only (O1). English only at launch (census, Eric 2026-10-09); All five tiers are built; Medium to Expert serve only seeds verified at build time (assets/spelluzzle/seeds-en.json). A Jr profile gets Spell Jr boards only. On by default for TestFlight (Eric, 2026-10-09); kill-switch is the spelluzzle flag (F13). Never ko, zh, ja, ar or hi (F12).

CC-BOARD-GAME v1.2 D26: roll-and-spell race on a ring of tiles. App only (I13): cfg, registry strip, BOARDGAME markup sentinels and the bg. locale prefix. Spell Jr is the same mode with the Jr variant (ceiling:medium). The group is PROVISIONAL (spell_it): D26 leaves it to Eric at build time, and choosing one edits the signed d_n6_membership_is_what_was_signed test. Per-language availability is boardgame_pools::gate (F9): a language short of the unique-word floor shows coming soon.

CC-ONBOARD-JR option (a): the base game. Its difficulty selector is LEVEL_OPTS, now filtered through experience::allowed_tiers. Core: never a hub tile. CC-HUB-DEADROWS F2 (Eric, 2026-10-02): unlisted, because its drawer row was the surface the drawer opens over -- tapping it closed the drawer and arrived, which reads as a dead row. Closing the drawer still arrives; there is simply no row claiming to take you somewhere.

modes.$hubTileNote: D1 SIGNED (Eric, 2026-09-02): out of the home row. The MODE is untouched -- Climb stays a LEVEL_OPTS entry and is selectable from the setup chip; shields, leaderboard and scoring are unchanged. CC-HUB-NAV v1.3.1 H1. Two players, one device -- no network, no chat, which is why it is kidSafe and ungated, matching what vsBtn already does in Kid Mode today. `core` like the base game, the Climb and the Daily: it always runs and has no flag, so it is governed here and rendered elsewhere. It had no registry entry at all until F2 deleted the tile that was its only door.
